name: Claude Code Bridge
description: Integrates Claude Code CLI with Nova via the WebSocket MCP protocol, providing context sharing, diff viewing, and selection tracking.

sections.name: Recent Sessions
sections.placeholderText: No saved sessions for this workspace.

headerCommands.title: Open
headerCommands.tooltip: Open the Claude chat UI in your browser

config.title: Path to Node.js
config.description: Path to the node executable used for the WebSocket server helper.

config.title: Auto-reject pending diffs after (minutes)
config.description: If a diff stays in the Pending Diffs queue longer than this, the bridge auto-rejects it so Claude isn't stuck waiting on a dead requestId. Set to 0 to disable.

config.title: Terminal Application
values: Just copy the command to clipboard
config.description: Where the "Launch Claude Code" command opens the CLI. Other terminals (Warp, Ghostty, Hyper) fall back to clipboard — choose "clipboard" explicitly to keep the v0.1.x behaviour.

config.title: Auto-check for Claude Code updates
config.description: Check daily for new Claude Code CLI versions when the extension activates. Only shows a notification when an update is available.

config.title: Update channel
config.description: Which npm dist-tag to compare against. "next" surfaces pre-release versions.

config.title: Enable Chat UI (Mode B — experimental)
config.description: Opt-in to the in-browser chat UI powered by the Claude Agent SDK. Requires an Anthropic API key. When enabled, a chat server starts on the configured port; open the URL in Safari/Firefox or in Nova's Preview tab. Independent from the existing CLI bridge mode.

config.title: Keychain service (advanced — point to an existing entry from another app)
config.description: macOS Keychain service identifier used to read/write the chat API key. Default is this extension's own namespace. Set this to another service (e.g. `com.anthropic.claudefordesktop` or `Cline`) if you already have an Anthropic key stored by another tool — both `Set` and `Clear` commands will then operate on that entry, so use with care.

config.title: Keychain account name
config.description: Account name within the Keychain service above. Together they form the (service, account) pair that uniquely identifies the entry.

config.title: Anthropic API Key — 1Password reference (optional)
config.description: 1Password CLI reference like `op://Private/Anthropic API Key/credential`. Requires an active `op signin` session ; expires after ~30 min, then chat init fails silently until re-signin. The macOS Keychain (set via 'Set Claude Chat API Key' command) is the recommended source — persistent, no session expiry.

config.title: Anthropic API Key — direct (last-resort fallback)
config.description: Plain-text API key — used only if both the Keychain AND 1Password reference are empty. Stored in Nova settings (not encrypted at rest). Prefer the Keychain via 'Set Claude Chat API Key' command.

config.title: Chat model
config.description: Model used by the chat UI. Sonnet 4.6 hits the sweet spot for cost/quality.

config.title: Chat UI port
config.description: Fixed port for the chat HTTP server. Configure Nova's Project Settings → Preview URL to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ to use the chat UI inside the Preview tab.

configWorkspace.title: Claude CLI command
configWorkspace.description: Command to launch Claude Code CLI.

configWorkspace.title: Extra Claude CLI arguments
configWorkspace.description: Arguments appended after the Claude command on launch (e.g. "--continue", "--model claude-opus-4-7", "--dangerously-skip-permissions"). Leave blank for default behaviour.
